text: The stack is chosen -- Databricks, Delta Lake, Fabric, and Kafka. Before writing one table, we whiteboard how scan and GPS data moves through Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
Bronze lands every Kafka event exactly as it arrived, append-only, never edited. Silver cleans, types, and deduplicates on event ID. Gold is the one governed answer every team queries.
The most important table in this whole build is package_status_gold -- one row per package, defined once, ordered by the event's own timestamp, not by when Databricks happened to see it.
We're locking the Unity Catalog names now -- fernbridge, with bronze, silver, and gold schemas -- so every later lesson in this series points at the exact same tables.
The layering is set. Next: splitting the infrastructure itself between Terraform and Bicep before any Azure resource exists.
